title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
abstract: arXiv:2610.00102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. translated_title: 基于多专家区间目标的不确定性感知学习
translated_abstract: 许多机器学习（ML）应用依赖于专家标签，而合格的专家可能对同一观测结果给出不同但都合理的解释。专家标签之间的这种差异可能反映了真实的分歧或模糊性，而非标注错误。当专家进一步报告的是区间而非精确值时，监督信号中就包含了两种不同的标签不确定性来源：标签内的不精确性和专家间的差异。现有方法将这些形式分开处理：多专家方法将标签压缩为共识，区间目标方法通常只产生单一预测，而预测不确定性方法很少将其不确定性估计与观察到的专家分歧进行对照验证。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种方法，该方法保留各位专家各自的区间，将标签内不精确性与专家间差异分离开来，并对相应的预测进行验证……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种不确定性感知的学习方法，通过保留多专家各自的区间标签、将标签内不精确性与专家间差异这两种不确定性来源分离，并将模型预测的不确定性与其观察到的专家分歧进行对照验证，从而改进从多专家区间目标中的学习。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an uncertainty-aware learning approach that preserves individual expert intervals, disentangles within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates predictive uncertainty against observed expert disagreement.
